spec.description: Patroni cluster health, roles and replication monitoring. Requires prometheus-type sources configured in pgwatch.

spec.title: WAL Write Location (Primary)
spec.description: WAL write location in bytes. Non-zero only on the primary node.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_xlog_location')::float AS value
FROM patroni_xlog_location
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: WAL Received Location (Replicas)
spec.description: WAL received vs replayed location on replica nodes in bytes

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_xlog_received_location')::float AS value
FROM patroni_xlog_received_location
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: WAL Replayed Location (Replicas)
spec.description: WAL replayed location on replica nodes in bytes

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_xlog_replayed_location')::float AS value
FROM patroni_xlog_replayed_location
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: DCS Last Seen Age
spec.description: Seconds since each node last successfully contacted the DCS (etcd/Consul/ZooKeeper). High values indicate DCS connectivity issues.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric,
  extract(epoch from now())::bigint - (data->>'patroni_dcs_last_seen')::bigint AS value
FROM patroni_dcs_last_seen
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Node Role
spec.description: Current role of each Patroni node: PRIMARY (1) or REPLICA (0)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_primary')::float AS value
FROM patroni_primary
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Clusters Monitored
spec.description: Total number of Patroni clusters currently monitored

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT tag_data->>'scope')::float AS value
FROM patroni_primary
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

spec.title: Clusters Without Leader
spec.description: Clusters missing a leader lock (split-brain risk). Should be 0.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)::float AS value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'scope')
    (data->>'patroni_cluster_unlocked')::int AS unlocked
  FROM patroni_cluster_unlocked
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  ORDER BY tag_data->>'scope', time DESC
) latest
WHERE unlocked = 1

spec.title: Paused Clusters
spec.description: Clusters with auto-failover paused. Should be 0 in normal operation.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)::float AS value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'scope')
    (data->>'patroni_is_paused')::int AS is_paused
  FROM patroni_is_paused
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  ORDER BY tag_data->>'scope', time DESC
) latest
WHERE is_paused = 1

spec.title: Nodes Pending Restart
spec.description: Nodes requiring a Postgres restart to apply configuration changes

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)::float AS value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dbname)
    (data->>'patroni_pending_restart')::int AS pending
  FROM patroni_pending_restart
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  ORDER BY dbname, time DESC
) latest
WHERE pending = 1

spec.title: Cluster Health Summary
spec.description: Per-cluster health summary. Use the Cluster variable above to filter the node detail panels below.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest_primary AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dbname)
    tag_data->>'scope' AS cluster,
    dbname,
    (data->>'patroni_primary')::int AS is_primary
  FROM patroni_primary
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  ORDER BY dbname, time DESC
),
cluster_unlocked AS (
  SELECT tag_data->>'scope' AS cluster,
    max((data->>'patroni_cluster_unlocked')::int) AS unlocked
  FROM patroni_cluster_unlocked
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1
),
cluster_paused AS (
  SELECT tag_data->>'scope' AS cluster,
    max((data->>'patroni_is_paused')::int) AS is_paused
  FROM patroni_is_paused
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1
),
cluster_pending AS (
  SELECT tag_data->>'scope' AS cluster,
    max((data->>'patroni_pending_restart')::int) AS pending_restart
  FROM patroni_pending_restart
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  lp.cluster AS "Cluster",
  count(*) AS "Nodes",
  sum(lp.is_primary)::int AS "Primaries",
  CASE WHEN cu.unlocked = 0 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "Has Leader",
  CASE WHEN cp.is_paused = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "Paused",
  CASE WHEN cpe.pending_restart = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "Pending Restart"
FROM latest_primary lp
LEFT JOIN cluster_unlocked cu USING (cluster)
LEFT JOIN cluster_paused cp USING (cluster)
LEFT JOIN cluster_pending cpe USING (cluster)
GROUP BY lp.cluster, cu.unlocked, cp.is_paused, cpe.pending_restart
ORDER BY lp.cluster

spec.title: Postgres Running
spec.description: Whether Postgres process is running on each node (1 = running)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_postgres_running')::float AS value
FROM patroni_postgres_running
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Cluster Leader Lock
spec.description: Whether the cluster has a distributed lock (leader). 0 = has leader (healthy), 1 = no leader (split-brain risk)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_cluster_unlocked')::float AS value
FROM patroni_cluster_unlocked
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Failover State
spec.description: Whether automatic failover is paused for the cluster (1 = paused)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_is_paused')::float AS value
FROM patroni_is_paused
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Pending Restart
spec.description: Node requires Postgres restart to apply configuration changes (1 = restart needed)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_pending_restart')::float AS value
FROM patroni_pending_restart
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Standby Leader
spec.description: Whether node is a standby leader (replica that manages the standby cluster, 1 = standby leader)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_standby_leader')::float AS value
FROM patroni_standby_leader
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: WAL Timeline
spec.description: PostgreSQL WAL timeline number per node

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_postgres_timeline')::float AS value
FROM patroni_postgres_timeline
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: PostgreSQL State
spec.description: Current Patroni PostgreSQL state per node. See table legend below for state values.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, dbname AS metric, (data->>'patroni_postgres_state')::float AS value
FROM patroni_postgres_state
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname IN ($dbname)
ORDER BY time
